decisions.reason: These reader and writer plug-ins build directly on the firm's core geospatial integration knowledge and product architecture, so absorptive capacity and ongoing R&D make continued improvement more likely than withdrawal.

Authentication and identity delegation is somewhat more adjacent than core GIS functionality, but it is close enough to the firm's software and integration base that management would likely keep learning from customer use and refine it rather than exit.

An open GIS application development framework is a strategic platform product that closely matches the firm's established software, standards, and consulting capabilities, which argues strongly for retention.

Because this identity and access service is explicitly aimed at GIS applications, it has a strong fit with the firm's existing customers and technical knowledge, supporting continued commercialization.

The consulting workshop draws directly on the firm's established geodata, training, and process-integration expertise, so even with a shorter track record it is more likely to be adapted and kept than taken off the market.
